_comment: Each case's intro PR added most of the lines its fix later removed (checked with git). Add a case only after confirming the bug's code came from that PR.

bugs.description: Studio accepts a hire pay growth limit above the server's 25% maximum and inverted min/max raise or hire pay limits, so Auto-Calibrate starts a run that fails with a raw validation error.
Contributions apply the year-end deferral rate to the whole year, so a mid-year enrollee or a mid-year escalation contributes as if the rate applied since January.
Legacy match-eligibility edits store match_allow_new_hires, so a later service requirement can't re-derive the new-hire match waiver on export.
The calibration target picker shows 'Workspace baseline' even when no scenario has that name and submits scenario_id null (workspace defaults), which may not match any completed scenario run.
Calibration rejects a scenario whose saved census override points to a deleted import, instead of falling back to the workspace census the way normal simulation does.
Scenario comparison plots a missing year's headcount as zero, so unequal simulation horizons look like a workforce collapse.

Event publication's delete-then-insert into fct_yearly_events fails ('another transaction has altered this table') when the existing table's column types differ from the rebuilt rows, e.g. in a copied calibration database.
